scenes.description: Une petite place à l’heure bleue. Deux personnes traversent le même espace sans encore se connaître.
scenes.visual_prompt: Original short film. Blue hour on a modest pedestrian square. Two original adult characters, A in a teal coat and B in a rust jacket. Establish the geography, keep the same square and lighting for the sequence. Wide shot, restrained slow camera approach.

scenes.description: Travelling avec A. Un petit objet jaune dépasse de sa poche ; B apparaît au second plan.
scenes.visual_prompt: Same square, blue hour, same teal coat character A and rust jacket character B. Lateral tracking shot beside A. A small yellow keepsake is visible at the edge of A's pocket. B remains in the background on the established side of the action axis. Natural restrained performance.

scenes.description: L’objet tombe. Le geste de B interrompt sa chute et attire le regard de A.
scenes.visual_prompt: Same original yellow keepsake, same blue-hour light and ground texture. Close shot of the keepsake falling from A's teal coat pocket; B's hand enters and catches it near the ground. One clear action, preserve object shape, no extra fingers or duplicated objects.

scenes.description: B rend l’objet à A. Un regard et un sourire suffisent ; aucun dialogue imposé.
scenes.visual_prompt: Same square and established screen direction. Medium two-shot: adult B in rust jacket returns the small yellow keepsake to adult A in teal coat. A quiet grateful glance and a small smile. Same faces, clothes, object and light as previous shots. Subtle camera approach, no dialogue required.

scenes.description: A remarque que B cherche son chemin et lui indique une direction. Le geste reçu devient un geste offert.
scenes.visual_prompt: Same two original adult characters and square. A now securely holds the yellow keepsake. B looks uncertain about the direction; A indicates the correct path with an open hand. Over-shoulder framing, maintain the established action axis and matching light. Convey reciprocity through readable body language.

scenes.description: La caméra s’élève doucement. A et B reprennent leur route. La place demeure vivante et le film se termine sur le mouvement.
scenes.visual_prompt: Return to the same modest pedestrian square at blue hour. Original characters A in teal and B in rust walk away along their established paths. Slow crane-up reveals the shared space; preserve spatial continuity and scale. Calm, warm ending without logos or imposed text.
